title: InterpreterSettings
description: Mirrors the subset of hayro_interpret::InterpreterSettings this bridge exposes. This is documentation, kept in sync by hand with the InterpreterSettingsJson struct in src/lib.rs, not used at runtime.

render_page.description: The content stream of the page; maps to RenderContent::PAGE. Absent means "use hayro's default" (read from InterpreterSettings::default()).

render_annotations.description: The annotations of the page; maps to RenderContent::ANNOTATIONS. Absent means "use hayro's default" (read from InterpreterSettings::default()).
